items.title: Introducing Qwen1.5
items.summary: GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DEMO DISCORD Introduction In recent months, our focus has been on developing a “good” model while optimizing the developer experience. As we progress towards Qwen1.5, the next iteration in our Qwen series, this update arrives just before the Chinese New Year. items.summaryZh: 通义千问迎来重要迭代，正式推出Qwen1.5系列大模型。此次更新全面开源了从0.5B、1.8B、4B、7B、14B、32B、72B到110B共六种尺寸的基础与聊天模型，并包含MoE架构版本，旨在进一步优化开发者的使用体验并推动开源生态发展。
